At the lower right there is also Pd(II), and metal-related connections with carbon and I are shown; there are B: and multiple arrows in the figure. Reasoning: According to the specified method, first count the 6 C-C bonds around the benzene ring; then add the 1 single bond from the benzene ring to the central carbon, obtaining 7. The heavy-atom bonds of the five-membered heterocyclic/organometallic part are central C-S, S-C, C=N, N-C, C-central C, totaling 5, obtaining 12. Then add the metal-related heavy-atom bonds C-Pd and Pd-I, totaling 2, obtaining 14. Exclude the central C-H bond and the interactions represented by B: and the arrows.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First count the six C–C bonds around the benzene ring. Add the single bond from the benzene ring to the central carbon. Then count the heavy-atom bonds in the five-membered heterocyclic/organometallic portion: central C–S, S–C, C=N, N–C, and C–central C. Add the metal-related heavy-atom bonds shown, C–Pd and Pd–I. Exclude the central C–H bond and any interaction indicated only by curved arrows from B: or around Pd. Sum these subcounts to obtain the total.

method.method_draft: Build the heavy-atom adjacency graph from the drawing. The benzene carbons contribute degrees 13 in total: five ring carbons have degree 2 and the ipso carbon has degree 3 because it also bonds to the central carbon. The central carbon has 3 counted heavy-atom neighbors: phenyl, S, and the lower heterocycle carbon; do not count its H. S has degree 2, bonded to the central carbon and the imine carbon. The imine carbon has degree 2, bonded to S and N. N has degree 2, bonded to the imine carbon and the lower heterocycle carbon. The lower heterocycle carbon has degree 3, bonded to N, the central carbon, and Pd. Pd has degree 2, bonded to that carbon and I, and I has degree 1. Add the degrees and divide by 2 to get the number of unique non-H bonds.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧有一个苯环，苯环的 ipso 碳连接到中间碳；中间碳还连接到 S 原子和下方杂环碳，并标有一个 H。右侧五元杂环包含 S、一个亚胺碳、N、下方碳以及中间碳。下方碳还与 Pd(II) 相连，Pd(II) 下方连接 I。图中还有弯箭头和 B:，但题目要求忽略箭头，并且不计入氢相关键。

推理：按重原子邻接图计数。苯环 6 个碳的度数总和为 13：5 个普通环碳各为 2，ipso 碳为 3，因为它还与中间碳相连。中间碳有 3 个非氢邻居：苯基碳、S、下方杂环碳，不计 C-H。S 的度数为 2，连接中间碳和亚胺碳。亚胺碳度数为 2，连接 S 和 N。N 度数为 2，连接亚胺碳和下方杂环碳。下方杂环碳度数为 3，连接 N、中间碳和 Pd。Pd 度数为 2，连接该碳和 I。I 度数为 1。总度数 = 13 + 3 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 28。每条非氢键贡献两个端点，所以唯一非氢键数 = 28 / 2 = 14。
